questions.question: Explain the Just War theory and how it compares to Islamic teachings on war.

points.text: Just War theory (developed by Augustine and Aquinas) states war is only justified if it meets six criteria: legitimate authority, just cause, right intention, last resort, proportionality and reasonable chance of success.
